# The eBilling Company

> The eBilling Company builds The eBilling System, a matter-first enterprise
> legal management (ELM) and legal e-billing platform for in-house legal
> departments, with a collaboration portal for outside counsel.

## Positioning

The platform connects the legal operating lifecycle from business request and
matter creation through outside counsel collaboration, invoice review, budgets,
accruals, AP handoff, payment status, reconciliation, and reporting. It is
broader than a spend-only point tool because the matter remains the shared
system of record for both work and financial activity.

## Platform areas

- Intake and matter management: configurable requests, matter fields and
  layouts, people, tasks, key dates, files, risk, status, and search.
- Outside counsel collaboration: firm records, portal identities, matter
  updates, files, timekeepers, rates, budgets, accruals, and invoice submission.
- Legal e-billing: LEDES and PDF intake, manual entry, duplicate detection,
  rate and guideline validation, line-level adjustments, approvals, and
  corrected-invoice history.
- Budgets and accruals: matter, annual, and phase planning; firm proposal
  round-trips; close-calendar controls; and accrual collection.
- Finance loop: allocations, AP-ready batches, ERP-specific mappings, payment
  status, reconciliation history, and multi-currency support.
- Reporting and assisted analysis: spend, savings, firm, timekeeper, matter,
  and workload analysis with drill-down evidence, delivery, and export.
- Deployment choice: shared cloud, dedicated instance, or on-premises.

## Security statements

- Tenant, matter, and firm access boundaries are enforced with PostgreSQL
  row-level security in addition to application authorization.
- In-house and outside counsel users operate in distinct identity contexts.
- Material workflow and financial events retain append-only audit history.
- AI may assist review and report composition, but professional decisions and
  deterministic monetary calculations remain outside the model.
- The company does not currently represent the product as SOC 2 certified.
  Certification claims will be published only when earned.
